summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by TFI International Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the voting results of its annual meeting of shareholders held on April 27, 2026. The report discloses the election of nine director nominees, each receiving majority support (ranging from 88.78% to 99.82% 'For'), and the reappointment of Deloitte LLP as auditor. No special-situation triggers—such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes—are present. The document is a routine shareholder meeting disclosure. In US equivalent terms, it is comparable to an 8-K filing Item 5.07 submission of voting results.
